content:
`figure.figsize` controls the width and height of a figure in inches when the figure is created. It takes a tuple of two numbers: `(width, height)`.

```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Default figure size
plt.figure()
plt.plot([1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6])
plt.title("Default Size")
plt.show()
```

```python
# Custom figure size
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = (8, 6) # inches
plt.figure()
plt.plot([1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6])
plt.title("Custom Size (8x6)")
plt.show()
```

```python
# Another custom figure size
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = (10, 2)
plt.figure()
plt.plot([1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6])
plt.title("Custom Size (10x2)")
plt.show()
```
